description: This file defines the WidgetClickHandler class responsible for handling click events in a calendar widget within an Android application. It provides methods to generate PendingIntent instances for opening the app, viewing specific events, and refreshing the widget, while logging respective analytics events.

classes.name: WidgetClickHandler
classes.description: Handles click events for the calendar widget, providing methods to generate PendingIntents for user interactions with the widget components.

methods.name: getOpenAppIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent that opens the main activity of the app when the widget is clicked.

methods.name: getEventClickIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent to view a specific calendar event when selected.

methods.name: getRefreshIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent to refresh the widget.
